{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to only completed orders (exclude refunded)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"QA orders found in completed set: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Drop QA orders if any
if qa_orders.shape[0] > 0:
    df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
    print(f"Dropped {qa_orders.shape[0]} QA orders.")
else:
    df_clean = df_completed

# Now compute total revenue per channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel"}
